name: Oshikake Gemini
source:
Through a strange twist of fate, two adolescent twins take up lodging at their male cousin's house.

"I think I might like him, but..."

It all began with that thought, and from there, it took a little bit of courage to start luring him in...
But, before the two girls' seduction turns into a fierce competition which gets more and more furious, and starts to turn into a game of bigger and bigger proportions...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ033596.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
由于命运的奇怪转折，两个青春期的双胞胎寄宿在他们的表弟家里。

“我想我可能会喜欢他，但是……”

一切都是从这个想法开始的，从那时起，需要一点勇气才能开始引诱他……
然而，还没等两个女孩的勾引演变成一场愈演愈烈的激烈竞争，并开始演变成一场规模越来越大的游戏……
